title: DOM manipulation
goal: Read and update an element on the page.
explanation: The Document Object Model represents a document as nodes. querySelector returns the first matching element, or null if no match exists.
Use textContent to insert plain text. Setting innerHTML parses markup and is dangerous when the value comes from an untrusted source.
Run code after the relevant elements exist, for example with a deferred external script. Check for a missing element when code can run on different pages.
exercise: Add a paragraph with id="message" and change its text with JavaScript.
hint: The selector needs # because you are looking up an id.

quiz.question: Which property safely inserts a visitor name as plain text?
quiz.explanation: textContent treats the value as text rather than executable markup.
